title: Cicmany house front
summary: Paint a house front in white on dark wood: a frame, zigzags, a sun wheel with rays, triangles and dots.
howToPlay: The lit panel shows the finished painting.
Tap a colour to dip the brush; drag along the guide for a line, or tap a shape to fill it.
Each step has its own lit strokes and shapes; Undo takes back the last one.
rules: Steps run in order; each must be finished before the next.
Score: strokes on the guide in the right colour and shapes filled in the right colour.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Watch and learn carves and waxes a whole round for you.
heritageNote: In Čičmany, a mountain village in Slovakia, log houses are decorated in white lime with zigzags, wheels and diamonds. The patterns are drawn freehand with a stick or brush on the dark timber.
